headings.instruction: Use for all main section titles and hero. Apply tracking-tight for high-end editorial feel.

body.instruction: Use for all body text, UI elements, buttons, and booking form. High legibility.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl or backdrop-blur-2xl on dark mode cards. Border MUST be 1px solid rgba(229, 193, 205, 0.15) for crispness.
visual_enhancers.lighting: Subtle radial gradient behind hero text and key interactive elements using #D4AF37 at 10% opacity.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Smooth hover lifts (-translate-y-1) on cards, tactile scale down on button click (scale-95).
visual_enhancers.motion: Framer motion for smooth liquid transitions. Staggered fade-ins for service menu list items.

layouts.hero: Full height or max-h-[80vh]. Central large editorial typography. Carousel of salon interior photos with heavy overlay for text readability (e.g., bg-black/40).
layouts.menu_section: Dual category tabs (Men / Women). Bento-style grid for service cards. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3.
layouts.booking_modal: Multi-step flow, central floating glass modal with z-50 overlay. Minimalist progress indicator.
layouts.manager_dashboard: Dense data layout. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 for stats, and table for booking feed. Strict hierarchical spacing.

components.name: LuxuryButton
components.instruction: Pill-shaped, background gradient or solid Champagne Gold. Hover effect: slight glow and text color change.

components.name: ServiceCard
components.instruction: Glassmorphism card in dark mode, flat subtle shadow card in light mode. Contains price, duration, and '+ Add to Booking' chip.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary buttons and text pass APCA. Dark mode text must be highly visible.
accessibility.focus_states: Use ring-2 ring-[#D4AF37] ring-offset-2 for focus states on inputs and buttons.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid based on role.

Chic modern beauty salon with black and white decor

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Apple-grade luxury aesthetic: high contrast, smooth typography scales, negative space.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or native <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components for all forms.
Implement file extensions as .js / .jsx, NOT .tsx, as the environment uses JavaScript.
Ensure dark mode is the default for a premium salon vibe, with a toggle for the off-white light mode.
Include actual WhatsApp integration link (wa.me/919494542999) with a pre-filled booking summary text.
For the Manager Dashboard, create a clean tabular layout for bookings with status badges.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped) with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
